item.name: Crackers
item.description: Shelf-stable crackers selected for the Cheese of the Day.
item.readyBeforeUse: Crackers are sealed or protected from dust, moisture, pests, and public contact.

item.ifNotReady: Do not serve damp, dusty, open, or contaminated crackers.
